body.message: Thank you for your time and effort to help. To be honest i am between 2 places, and the other place i can get for 7500 for 3 months for a bigger space. Im willing to go up to 8k max only because i love the location of Le Mer. If thats not possible then we can leave it here unfortunately. Please let me know if we can agree on 8k, if so i will send the deposit immediately
